title: Bringing an AI SaaS Platform to Life Through Interactive Storytelling
summary: BEFO AI is an innovative SaaS platform that leverages artificial intelligence to streamline ERP implementation planning, with a particular focus on Odoo deployments. The challenge was to communicate a complex technical product in a way that was both engaging and easy to understand. Admonk designed a modern digital experience featuring custom motion graphics, interactive animations, and product-focused storytelling that clearly demonstrates the platform's value while reinforcing its position as an AI-first technology company.

challenge.title: BEFO AI needed to explain a complex AI-powered ERP planning platform in a simple and engaging way.
items: The product concept was technical and needed clearer storytelling.
The website had to explain AI, ERP, and Odoo implementation visually.
Motion graphics were required to make the platform feel alive.
The layout needed to build trust for a new SaaS startup.
